record.evidence_quote: ionic conductivity of ~ 3 x 10-4 Ω-1cm-1 at 200oC which is one order of magnitude rise
record.notes: The composite is NZSP with 4 wt% NaI; the abstract does not name the composition on this line but states the 4% NaI composite shows the maximum. Unit Ω-1cm-1 equals S/cm. Sintering values are for the general preparation route (calcined 700 C, sintered 1000 C for 2 h). Conductivity kind is not specified. The paper calls NaI a dopant in its conclusions but describes it as a composite additive.
